learning.title: A new Better Auth provider table must join resetTestDatabase or every later fixture fails
learning.trigger: A provider migration (public.* tables from a plugin) is added.
learning.mistake: The confirmed test reset drops a fixed list of provider tables. A plugin table missing from it survives the reset while the migration ledger is wiped, so the next fixture re-runs the migration and fails with "relation already exists" across the whole integration lane.
learning.rule: Add each new public table to the drop list in apps/server/src/platform/migrate.ts, the expected ledger lists in tests/integration/implement-checksum-migrations-and-isolated-database-fixtures_test.ts and tests/unit/implement-local-skill-catalog-publication_test.ts, then run the checksum migration test.

verification.requirement: implement-checksum-migrations-and-isolated-database-fixtures_test.ts passes and a second integration file in the same deno test process still opens its fixture.
